sports.image_caption: Ravindra Jadeja during India's warm-up match against SL XI ahead of the test series in Sri Lanka. The all-rounder's imitation of Kuldeep Yadav's bowling action left coach Gautam Gambhir in splits.
sports.nri_angle: Light-hearted team moment ahead of India's Sri Lanka test series resonates with Indian cricket fans worldwide.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: SpaceX Launches 24 Starlink Satellites From California in 90th Falcon 9 Mission of 2026
technology.excerpt: SpaceX deployed another batch of Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base as the company pushes past 10,800 satellites in orbit and maintains its record-setting launch cadence.
technology.image_caption: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifts off from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. The launch carried 24 Starlink satellites to orbit, marking the 90th Falcon 9 mission of 2026.
technology.nri_angle: Starlink's global expansion offers improved broadband for diaspora communities in underserved areas, though its entry into India remains pending regulatory approval.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Indian-American Teen Sharvi Mahajan Builds AI System to Detect Driver Fatigue, Named 3M Finalist
technology.excerpt: The 14-year-old San Diego student's NeuroDrive Alert uses EEG and machine learning to identify microsleep before it causes accidents, earning her a shot at the $25,000 top prize.
technology.image_caption: Sharvi Mahajan with her NeuroDrive Alert project at the 3M Young Scientist Challenge. The 14-year-old Indian-American student developed an AI-powered system to detect driver fatigue using EEG sensors.
technology.nri_angle: Five of ten finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge are Indian American, reflecting a broader pattern of diaspora dominance in youth STEM competitions.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: TCS Launches Biggest Leadership Overhaul in Three Years to Counter AI Disruption
technology.excerpt: India's largest IT services company has reshuffled a dozen senior executives, split its banking division, and created five new business units after posting its first annual revenue decline since going public.
technology.image_caption: Tata Consultancy Services has reassigned about a dozen senior executives in its largest leadership overhaul in three years to sharpen its response to AI disruption.
technology.nri_angle: TCS is one of the largest employers of Indian IT professionals globally, and its restructuring signals how AI is reshaping career paths across the diaspora's dominant industry.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: xAI's Imagine Image 2.0 Enters Top Five as OpenAI's GPT-Image-2 Dominates Arena Benchmarks
technology.excerpt: Elon Musk's xAI closes the gap with a new quality mode for Grok's image generator, but OpenAI's reasoning-powered model holds a record 242-point lead on the Arena leaderboard.
technology.nri_angle: Advances in AI image generation are reshaping creative workflows for developers, designers, and content creators globally, including Indian tech professionals building visual tools and marketing assets.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: R Madhavan Pushes Back on Propaganda Tag: 'Being Indian Cannot Be a Crime'
entertainment.excerpt: The actor defends Dhurandhar and Rocketry against accusations of nationalistic propaganda, saying honest storytelling about Indian identity should not be controversial.
entertainment.image_caption: R Madhavan speaks during a promotional interview. The actor addressed accusations of propaganda surrounding his roles in Dhurandhar and Rocketry: The Nambi Effect.
entertainment.nri_angle: Madhavan's defense of depicting Indian identity in cinema resonates with diaspora audiences who follow Bollywood's evolving global representation and the debate around nationalism in Indian entertainment.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Yash Unveils 'Toxic' Trailer at Bengaluru Event, Confirms Dual Father-Son Role
entertainment.excerpt: The KGF star returns after a four-year hiatus with a gangster saga featuring Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, and an ensemble cast, releasing August 26 in IMAX worldwide.
entertainment.image_caption: Yash at the trailer launch event for Toxic in Bengaluru. The Kannada star confirmed he plays a dual father-son role in the gangster thriller directed by Geetu Mohandas.
entertainment.nri_angle: Yash's KGF franchise established Kannada cinema globally; Toxic's multi-language IMAX release with Lionsgate distribution extends that reach for diaspora audiences.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Mohanlal Apologises After Visa Issue Forces Cancellation of Sydney Stage Show
entertainment.excerpt: The Malayalam superstar said it was the first time in his life he had been denied a visa, calling the situation 'helpless' as fans in Australia were left disappointed.
entertainment.image_caption: Malayalam superstar Mohanlal at a public event. The actor apologised to fans after a visa issue forced the cancellation of his scheduled stage show in Sydney.
entertainment.nri_angle: The cancellation directly affected Indian diaspora fans in Sydney who had been eagerly awaiting the show. Australia's large Indian community, combined with ongoing visa service disruptions, makes this a story of direct relevance to NRIs in Australia.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Keerthy Suresh Fires Back at Claims She Took The Paradise Dance Number Due to 'Lack of Roles'
entertainment.excerpt: The National Award-winning actress responded with a sharp 'chinna correction' after a social media user suggested she accepted the special song in Nani's upcoming film because she lacked substantial roles.
entertainment.nri_angle: Keerthy Suresh is one of the most prominent South Indian actresses with a growing fanbase in the diaspora. The Paradise's multi-language release including English and Spanish makes it one of the most accessible South Indian films globally.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Mithun Chakraborty Undergoes Surgery in Kolkata to Remove Metal Plate From Earlier Injury
entertainment.excerpt: The veteran Bollywood actor and BJP leader is in stable condition after the procedure, with West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari and actor Dev Adhikari visiting him in hospital.
entertainment.image_caption: Veteran Bollywood actor Mithun Chakraborty underwent surgery at a Kolkata hospital to remove a metal plate from an earlier spinal injury.
entertainment.nri_angle: Mithun Chakraborty is a beloved figure among the Indian diaspora, with his films from the 1980s and 1990s forming a cultural touchstone for NRIs worldwide.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: TV Star Charlie Chauhan Marries KKR All-Rounder Ramandeep Singh After Eight-Year Romance
entertainment.excerpt: The Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan actress and India T20I cricketer tied the knot in a traditional Sikh ceremony at a gurdwara on August 7.
entertainment.image_caption: Television actress Charlie Chauhan and cricketer Ramandeep Singh at their wedding ceremony. The couple married in a traditional Sikh ceremony on August 7 after an eight-year relationship.
entertainment.nri_angle: The wedding of a popular Indian TV actress and IPL cricketer resonates with diaspora audiences who follow both Indian entertainment and cricket closely.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Over 3,000 Run in Chennai's Singapenn Marathon to Combat India's Cervical Cancer Crisis
lifestyle-health.excerpt: India accounts for 25% of all cervical cancer deaths worldwide, organizers say, as the marathon also promoted the national women's safety helpline.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Participants in the Singapenn marathon along Chennai Marina Beach on Sunday. More than 3,000 people joined the run to raise awareness about cervical cancer and women safety.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: India's cervical cancer burden and the growing health awareness movement in Indian cities matter to diaspora communities invested in public health outcomes back home.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India Flags Ultra-Processed Food Health Risks as ICMR Data Shows Rising NCD Burden
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A Union Health Minister's statement in Parliament cites ICMR research linking packaged food consumption to diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular disease as India's UPF market crosses $38 billion.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) logo. ICMR data shows rising consumption of ultra-processed foods is contributing to India's growing burden of non-communicable diseases.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face elevated genetic risk for diabetes and cardiovascular disease, making ICMR's findings on ultra-processed food risks directly relevant to diaspora families maintaining dual dietary patterns.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: 7 Breakfast Foods an AIIMS-Trained Doctor Recommends for Fatty Liver
lifestyle-health.excerpt: From oats and Greek yogurt to walnuts and green tea, a gastroenterologist trained at AIIMS, Harvard, and Stanford shares practical morning meal choices to support liver health.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A spread of liver-friendly breakfast foods including oats, nuts, fruits, and yogurt. Experts recommend these options to reduce fat buildup and support liver health in patients with NAFLD.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Fatty liver disease affects an estimated one in three Indians, making these evidence-based breakfast recommendations particularly relevant for the diaspora community.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: From Chennai Handlooms to Dior Runways: How Madras Checks Conquered Global Fashion
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The checked cotton fabric born on India's Coromandel coast has travelled through colonial trade, Ivy League wardrobes and high fashion — and is now finding its way home.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Handloom Madras check fabric displays the distinctive colourful plaid pattern originating from Chennai. The textile has been adopted by global fashion houses while Indian designers work to revive authentic handloom production.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Madras checks have been a familiar sight in diaspora wardrobes for decades, and their revival connects NRIs to India's textile heritage.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Rujuta Diwekar's Three Forgotten Summer Coolants That Need No Electricity or AC
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Celebrity nutritionist recommends vetiver-infused water, mehendi, and buttermilk as traditional Indian solutions to beat the summer heat without modern appliances.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Traditional Indian cooling practices relevant to diaspora families seeking affordable, natural alternatives to stay cool during summer months
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Coastal Karnataka's Ancient Food-as-Medicine Tradition Is Vanishing, Workshop Warns
food.excerpt: At a workshop near Mangalore, scholars and food creators say traditional dishes calibrated to seasonal health needs are being lost to steel vessels and gas stoves.
food.image_caption: Speakers at the Disappearing Tulunadu Food Culture workshop at the Rani Abbakka Tulu Museum in B.C. Road near Mangalore. The event highlighted the erosion of traditional cooking methods in coastal Karnataka.
food.nri_angle: The disappearing food traditions of Tulu Nadu resonate with the large Mangalorean diaspora's cultural connection to their homeland cuisine.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Doodhi Halwa: How to Make the Classic Bottle Gourd Dessert Without Khoya
food.excerpt: This simplified Punjabi recipe turns a humble lauki into a rich, cardamom-scented halwa in under 45 minutes — no specialty ingredients required.
food.image_caption: A serving of doodhi halwa garnished with chopped nuts and saffron strands. The traditional Punjabi dessert is made from grated bottle gourd slow-cooked with milk, sugar, and cardamom.
food.nri_angle: Bottle gourd is increasingly available at Indian grocery stores and mainstream supermarkets in the US, UK, and Canada, making doodhi halwa an accessible traditional dessert for diaspora families.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: The Story of South Indian Filter Coffee: From Smuggled Beans to a Global Morning Ritual
food.excerpt: How seven coffee beans smuggled from Yemen in the 17th century gave rise to India's most beloved brewing tradition and a cultural identity that travels with the diaspora.
food.image_caption: A traditional South Indian steel coffee filter used to brew decoction by slow drip. The two-chambered device has been the heart of filter kaapi culture across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka for over a century.
food.nri_angle: Filter kaapi has followed the South Indian diaspora worldwide, with the steel filter and tumbler-dabara remaining essential items in NRI kitchens.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Kanwar Yatra Camps Blend Tradition and Street Food With 7,000 Rotis a Day
food.excerpt: Volunteer camps along the Uttar Pradesh pilgrimage route serve everything from shahi paneer and dal makhani to pizza, momos, and pasta — all prepared without onion and garlic.
food.image_caption: Kanwar Yatris carry holy water from the Ganges during the annual pilgrimage. Food camps along the route serve thousands of rotis and traditional street food daily.
food.nri_angle: The Kanwar Yatra is one of India's most iconic religious pilgrimages, and its evolving food culture reflects the broader fusion of tradition and modernity that resonates with the diaspora
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Three Indian Bars Crack Asia's 50 Best List as Goa's Boilermaker Storms Into Top 10
food.excerpt: Boilermaker in Goa jumped 22 places to No. 8, while Bengaluru's SOKA and Bar Spirit Forward reinforced the city's growing reputation as India's cocktail capital.
food.image_caption: The interior of Boilermaker in Siolim, Goa. The bar jumped 22 places to No. 8 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 and was named Best Bar in India.
food.nri_angle: India's growing presence on the global cocktail stage is a point of pride for NRIs, many of whom visit these bars when traveling home and follow the country's evolving food and drink scene.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Canada Airports Launch Free Flow Transit, Letting International Passengers Skip Border Checks
travel.excerpt: Toronto Pearson, Vancouver, and Montréal-Trudeau now let connecting international travelers bypass customs entirely, saving up to 60 minutes on layovers.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers routing through Canadian airports to the US will benefit from faster connections, especially on the popular Delhi/Mumbai-Toronto-US corridor.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taipei–Delhi Flights in December, Targeting India-US Transit Market
travel.excerpt: Taiwan's second-largest carrier plans to connect Delhi to its North American network of 10 cities, offering one-stop routes for Indian tech professionals heading to Silicon Valley.
travel.nri_angle: The new Taipei-Delhi route gives NRIs in the US, especially tech workers on the West Coast, a Pacific routing alternative for trips home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.image_caption: Jetstar Airways will begin charging passengers for overhead locker access on select routes starting February 2027.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ranthambore Safari Bookings Crash as Record Demand Overwhelms New Portal
travel.excerpt: Rajasthan's revamped booking website for India's most popular tiger reserve buckled under massive traffic as the October–December season opened, highlighting surging wildlife tourism demand.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs and international tourists planning India wildlife trips face the same booking gridlock, with the new portal requiring passport uploads and foreign cards often failing on Indian payment gateways.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Millions of Americans Discover Canadian Citizenship Pathway as Birthright Restrictions Loom
carousel.excerpt: Canada's Bill C-3 eliminated generational cutoffs for citizenship by descent, opening the door for millions of Americans with Canadian ancestry — just as the U.S. debates tightening its own birthright rules.
carousel.image_caption: A Canada-U.S. border crossing. Canada's Bill C-3 eliminates generational limits on citizenship by descent, opening a pathway for millions of Americans with Canadian-born parents or grandparents.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans on work-based visas face unique anxiety as the birthright citizenship debate adds uncertainty to immigration planning, while the Canadian pathway offers a potential second option for those with ancestral ties.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Andhra Pradesh Student Dileep Kumar Bungatavula Killed in Ohio After Pick-Up Truck Rams His Car Head-On
carousel.excerpt: The North America Telugu Society has launched a fundraiser to support the student's farming family back in Andhra Pradesh, adding to a grim toll of Indian student road fatalities in the US.
carousel.image_caption: The Prentice Memorial Gateway at Kent State University in Kent, Ohio. Dileep Kumar Bungatavula, a student from Andhra Pradesh based in Kent, was killed in a head-on collision with a pick-up truck.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian student from Andhra Pradesh killed in Ohio; Telugu diaspora organizations mobilize fundraising for his farming family.

carousel.excerpt: Operating profit rose 16% to $12.98 billion in the conglomerate's second quarter under CEO Greg Abel, while share repurchases surged nearly 20-fold from Q1.
